lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: finding an unknown side length from area or perimeter, and interpreting a line plot
lessonRef.title: Applied problem solving: finding an unknown side length from area or perimeter, and interpreting a line plot

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the problem below asks for.

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 48 square units and one side is 6 units. Find the other side.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what the problem is asking before you compute.

items.prompt: A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/4 yard: 4/4, 4/4, 2/4, 2/4, 2/4, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 1/4 yard?
A rectangle has area 15 square units and one side is 3 units. What is the length of the other side?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/4 yard: 2/4, 2/4, 2/4, 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 3/4, 4/4. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 4/4 yard?
A rectangle has area 80 square units and one side is 10 units. What is the length of the other side?
A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/8 yard: 6/8, 2/8, 2/8, 7/8, 1/8, 1/8, 8/8, 8/8. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 6/8 yard?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: A rectangle has area 110 square units and one side is 11 units. What is the length of the other side?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A line plot shows 8 ribbon lengths to the nearest 1/8 yard: 2/8, 8/8, 4/8, 7/8, 6/8, 2/8, 6/8, 8/8. What is the combined length, in a fraction of a yard, of all ribbons measuring exactly 7/8 yard?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
